headline: AYA ZGOUNDER HITS 783 G/T SILVER OVER 13M IN MOROCCO — WEST FAULT EXTENSION DRILLING ADVANCES IN H2 2026
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) reported September 16 high-grade silver results from Zgounder Silver Mine in Morocco — hole ZG-RC-24-155 returned 783 g/t Ag over 13.0 metres, hole ZG-RC-24-354 intercepted 501 g/t Ag over 11.0m including 4,000 g/t over 1.0m, and hole ZG-SF-25-702 hit 1,553 g/t Ag over 1.4m. The company has completed one-third of its 30,000-metre 2026 program, with development of an exploration drift at the 1825-metre level now advancing to unlock drilling west of the Western Fault in H2 2026 — a zone CEO Benoit La Salle describes as having 'significant exploration potential.'

headline: G MINING CONFIRMS NEW GRODIOCAL GOLD DISCOVERY AT GURUPI — 78M AT 1.81 G/T DEEPENS TZ PIT RESOURCE
snippet: G Mining Ventures (TSX: GMIN) released September 16 a dual-project exploration update: maiden drilling at the Grodiocal target within the Gurupi Project in northern Brazil confirmed a new near-surface gold discovery, while drilling 150 metres below the current Tocantinzinho pit design returned 78.1m at 1.81 g/t Au including 16.0m at 4.34 g/t Au and 51.0m at 1.31 g/t Au — confirming down-plunge continuity that expands the resource available for an open-pit scenario. Gurupi also extended known mineralization at the Blanket and Mandiocal deposits, reinforcing the district-scale potential of the project.

headline: METALSOURCE SILVER HILL REACHES 261 G/T AGEQ OVER 7M AT 245M — NORTH CAROLINA SYSTEM ENTERS MAJOR EXPANSION PHASE
snippet: Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE: MSM) announced September 16 additional assay results from its ongoing drill program at Silver Hill in North Carolina — hole SH26-22 returned 7.32 metres grading 261 g/t silver equivalent including 1.37m at 930 g/t AgEq from 245.67m depth, and hole SH26-23 returned 12.31m at 140 g/t AgEq including 1.86m at 833 g/t AgEq from 246.8m. Both holes extend high-grade polymetallic mineralization reliably at depth with consistent widths; the company is preparing significantly larger step-outs along strike as it enters a major expansion phase at America's only active historical silver mine.

headline: ATOMIC EAGLE FINDS TWO NEW URANIUM ZONES AT ZAMBIA'S MUNTANGA — 1KM×400M NAMAKANDE BODY ANCHORS NEXT DRILLING PHASE
snippet: Atomic Eagle (ASX: AEU) released a September 16 Muntanga Uranium Project update from Zambia identifying two new uranium mineralisation zones during the 2026 drilling program — a 600m × 200m zone at Muntanga North Target 5 and a 1,000m × 400m zone at Namakande — alongside expansion of the core Chisebuka deposit footprint to 900m × 600m in the northern zone and 830m × 400m in the southwest. Targets 6, 7, and 8 at Muntanga North remain completely undrilled and are described by management as large-scale early-stage targets representing the program's next major catalyst, with drilling expected to complete Q4 2026.

headline: LATIN EXPLORE DEFINES 1.8KM×1.6KM COPPER-MOLYBDENUM PORPHYRY AT PARA, PERU — 800M DEPTH EXTENT, PHASE 1 DRILL Q4
snippet: Latin Explore Inc. (TSXV: LXE) announced September 16 that new 3D modelling has defined a large, coherent priority drill target at its 100%-owned Para copper-molybdenum project in Peru's Arequipa region — a principal IP chargeability target measuring 1.8km × 1.6km extending from surface to approximately 800m depth, corroborated by a coincident magnetic low, hydrothermal alteration, and surface copper-molybdenum mineralization. Phase 1 drilling of approximately 2,000 metres — designed to test the interpreted porphyry core — is planned for Q4 2026 subject to outstanding regulatory approvals.

headline: SILEX LOCKS IN CAMECO OFFTAKE FOR ALL GLE LASER ENRICHMENT OUTPUT — PADUCAH NUCLEAR FUEL PLANT CLEARS KEY COMMERCIAL MILESTONE
snippet: Silex Systems (ASX: SLX) announced September 14 that Global Laser Enrichment — its 49%-owned laser enrichment joint venture with GE Hitachi — signed an exclusive offtake agreement with Cameco covering all future production from the planned Paducah Laser Enrichment Facility in Kentucky. Under the agreement, GLE will sell all future nuclear fuel output to Cameco at pricing equivalent to Cameco's average realised price net of selling costs, giving GLE a committed buyer and removing the need for its own sales infrastructure ahead of a Final Investment Decision for the Kentucky plant, which is designed to produce natural-grade, low-enriched, and high-assay low-enriched uranium for advanced reactors.

headline: COPPER STEADIES NEAR $14,000/T AS LME LOGS BIGGEST WAREHOUSE INFLOWS IN FOUR WEEKS — SHORT-TERM SUPPLY SQUEEZE EASES
snippet: Copper futures steadied near $14,000 a tonne ($6.35/lb) on September 15 as fresh metal deliveries to LME-tracked warehouses — the largest single-week inflow in nearly four weeks — eased the physical supply squeeze that drove the metal to a record close last week. The relief follows a near 5% price swing from record highs as market participants processed stalled US tariff plans on refined copper; however, structural headwinds remain intact with Grasberg still operating at 65% capacity through H2 2026, Escondida's feed grade declining toward 0.70% in FY27, and the ICSG having revised mine supply growth down to 1.6% for 2026.

headline: 1911 GOLD FUNDS TRUE NORTH TO PRODUCTION — FULLY PERMITTED MANITOBA MINE TARGETS 2027 RESTART ON $30M AURAMET CREDIT LINE
snippet: Crux Investor's September 15 deep-dive into 1911 Gold (TSXV: AUMB) examines the company's funded path to restart True North — a fully permitted, 61,000-hectare Manitoba gold operation with historical production of approximately 2.0 million ounces — underpinned by a C$30M credit facility from Auramet International. The 2026 PEA models an after-tax NPV5% of $391 million and a 105% IRR at a $3,000/oz gold base case; with gold above $4,300, those economics are dramatically better. A resource update due October 2026 is expected to add the Sam Southeast zone, and management is weighing whether to accelerate development — which would require additional funding beyond what is currently in place.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER'S 477% TSX30 RUN COMES WITH A FUNDED SILVER-ANTIMONY RESTART — CRUX PROFILES THE TURNAROUND
snippet: Crux Investor's September 15 analysis of Americas Gold & Silver Corp (TSX: USA) examines what drove the 477% three-year gain that landed the company 24th on the 2026 TSX30 — a combination of the sustained silver price move above $64/oz, antimony's emergence as a new margin driver at the Cosalá operations in Mexico, and a financed path to approximately 1,000 tpd capacity targeting 5 million ounces of annual silver production. The piece frames the company's trajectory as a case study in what leverage to silver looks like inside a properly structured junior-to-mid-tier transition when the metal cooperates.
